title: Rig
description: Rigid parts joined in a tree; clips rotate each part about its pivot. Cell grid: integers are cell centres, +Y up, +Z forward, +X the character's left, 1 cell = 1/16 m.

parts.description: Parts by name, parents before children; side names end in _l or _r.

parent.description: The part this one hangs from; null for the one root.

pivot.description: The joint the part rotates about; .5 lies on a cell face.
